# EBSource.ca

> > Canada's comprehensive resource for workplace benefits, employment law, retirement planning, payroll, and government programs for Canadian employees and employers.

EBSource.ca provides expert guidance on employee benefits, group insurance, Canadian pensions (CPP), tax filing (CRA requirements), provincial employment standards, and immigration programs. Content covers major provinces including Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Ontario, with contributions from benefits experts including David Lam, Ben Nguyen, Miley Ton, Harold Yang, Geoffrey Greenall, and Emma Bui.

## Key Topics

- Employee Benefits & Group Insurance
- Canada Pension Plan (CPP)
- Employment Insurance (EI)
- Canadian Revenue Agency (CRA) Tax Requirements
- Retirement Benefits & Pensions
- Employment Law & Employee Rights
- Government Benefits Programs
- Provincial Employment Standards (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, Ontario)
- Group vs Individual Insurance Coverage
- Critical Illness Insurance
- Disability Insurance (LTD/STD)
- Take-Home Pay & Salary Calculation
- Income Tax Brackets & Credits
- Workplace Discrimination Prevention
- Provincial Nominee Programs (PNPs)

## Employee Benefits & Group Insurance

- [The Ultimate Guide to Non-Taxable Employee Benefits in Canada](https://ebsource.ca/employee-benefits/non-taxable-benefits): Non-taxable benefits guide: CRA rules & employer deductions
- [Group Critical Illness Insurance vs Individual Policy](https://ebsource.ca/employee-benefits/group-insurance/critical-illness/group-critical-illness-vs-individual): Compares group vs individual critical illness insurance in Canada
- [Long Term vs Short Term Disability Insurance in a Group Plan](https://ebsource.ca/employee-benefits/group-insurance/disability/long-term-vs-short-term): LTD vs STD comparison: coverage, income replacement & group benefits
- [Preventive Care in Canada: The Essential Guide 2026](https://ebsource.ca/employee-benefits/group-insurance/health/preventive-care): Preventive care guide: screenings, vaccinations & insurance coverage
- [Employee Benefits Advisors in Canada](https://ebsource.ca/employee-benefits/plans-insights/benefits-advisors): Benefits advisors guide: Aon, Mercer & plan design consulting

## Retirement Plans & Pensions

- [Defined Benefit Pension Plan (DB) Canada: How Benefits Are Calculated](https://ebsource.ca/retirement-plans/workplace/defined-benefit-plans): DB pension plan guide: guaranteed retirement income calculation methods
- [Deferred Profit Sharing Plans (DPSP) in Canada](https://ebsource.ca/retirement-plans/workplace/deferred-profit-sharing-plans): DPSP guide: tax-deferred growth, employer contributions & withdrawals
- [OAS Payment Dates in Canada 2026: What You Need to Know](https://ebsource.ca/government-benefits/retirement/oas-payment-dates): 2026 OAS payment schedule, direct deposit & clawback information

## Payroll, Tax & Income Calculation

- [T4 Slip Guide 2026: Deadline, Requirements & Filling Tips](https://ebsource.ca/income-tax/t4-slip): T4 slip guide: deadlines, box meanings & accurate tax filing tips
- [Line 15000 Explained: The Tax Guide for Reporting All Income](https://ebsource.ca/income-tax/line-15000): Line 15000 total income reporting: employment, investments & pensions
- [How to Estimate Your Take-Home Pay in Alberta in 2026](https://ebsource.ca/payroll/take-home-pay/alberta-estimate): Alberta take-home pay calculator guide with CPP, tax rates & credits
- [Minimum Wage in British Columbia: Rates & Upcoming Changes](https://ebsource.ca/payroll/minimum-wage/british-columbia-rate): BC minimum wage rates, CPI adjustments & enforcement options

## Employment Law & Employee Rights

- [How to Prevent Discrimination in Your Workplace](https://ebsource.ca/employment-law/prevent-discrimination): Workplace discrimination prevention: policies, training & diversity tips
- [Temporary Layoffs in Canada: What You Need to Know](https://ebsource.ca/employment-law/temporary-layoffs): Temporary layoff rights: duration, pay, refusal & severance options

## Government Benefits & Provincial Programs

- [Ontario Guaranteed Annual Income System Payments for Seniors](https://ebsource.ca/government-benefits/ontario/gains): GAINS program guide: Ontario senior income support & eligibility
- [June Holiday in Newfoundland and Labrador: What employees should know](https://ebsource.ca/employee-benefits/leaves-and-time-off/holidays/newfoundland-and-labrador-june-holiday): NL June Holiday guide: eligibility, paid time off & employee rights

## Immigration & Provincial Nominee Programs

- [Saskatchewan Immigrant Nominee Program (SINP): 2025 Guide](https://ebsource.ca/immigrate/provincial-nominee-programs-pnps/saskatchewan-sinp): SINP guide: Saskatchewan immigration pathways & PR requirements
